evals.name: setup-wp-scripts
evals.prompt: Set up @wordpress/scripts build for my plugin with separate admin and frontend entry points.
evals.expected_output: Install @wordpress/scripts. Add package.json scripts (build, start). Create webpack.config.js extending defaultConfig with entry: { admin: './src/admin/index.js', frontend: './src/frontend/index.js' }. Enqueue using .asset.php dependencies and version hash in PHP. CSS extracted automatically.

evals.name: fix-asset-version
evals.prompt: The plugin scripts aren't cache-busting correctly — the version is hardcoded instead of using the build hash.
evals.expected_output: Read the enqueue code. Replace hardcoded version with require plugin_dir_path(__FILE__) . 'build/index.asset.php' and use $asset['version'] and $asset['dependencies']. Works for all entry points. Confirm .asset.php exists in build output.

evals.name: add-block-entries
evals.prompt: I have 5 blocks in src/blocks/ — set up webpack to auto-discover and build them all.
evals.expected_output: webpack.config.js uses glob to find ./src/blocks/*/index.js, reduces to entry object keyed as blocks/{name}. Extends defaultConfig entry. Output: build/blocks/{name}.js + build/blocks/{name}.asset.php. PHP registers each with register_block_type(__DIR__ . '/build/blocks/{name}').
